answer: Require each trading agent to lock a fixed bond for 30 days before earning marketplace rewards, with one reward quota per bond. Agents selling plume forecasts, mesa maps, or shale surveys face the same rule. Splitting into 1,000 identities therefore requires 1,000 bonds, making the attacker pay in locked capital rather than cheap account creation. The limitation is that wealthy operators can still buy influence, while small newcomers face a funding barrier.
